decisions.mark: names MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the gating macros
decisions.detail: QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`), and so are `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT`. Every mutex use in the library sits behind `#if defined(MBEDTLS_THREADING_C)`. | WHY: The answer names MBEDTLS_THREADING_C as the guard for mutex code and names MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the implementation option that must also be enabled, so both gating macros are identified. || QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`), and so are `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (lines 2185, 2196). Every mutex use in the library sits behind `#if defined(MBEDTLS_THREADING_C)`. | WHY: The answer names both MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the config macros that gate the library's locking, and says mutex use is guarded by them. || QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`), and so are `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (lines 2185, 2196). Every mutex use in the library sits behind `#if defined(MBEDTLS_THREADING_C)`. | WHY: The answer names MBEDTLS_THREADING_C as the guard for all mutex code and names MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the implementation option, which together cover the gating macros.
